visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a small white ceramic bowl with blue floral patterns. A hand uses wooden chopsticks to delicately pick up a thin, pale pink slice of pickled ginger. The background shows a wooden table and a blurred kitchen setting with soft indoor lighting. Yellow and pink text overlays appear at the center. (2) A silver wire mesh basket filled with approximately 600 grams of fresh young ginger stalks with pink tips is shown in a bright kitchen. A hand points at the pink sections of the ginger. (3) The ginger is moved to a yellow plastic cutting board. A sharp metal knife is used to slice off the small pink tips from the main stalks. (4) The scene transitions to a close-up of the ginger stalks. A small paring knife is used to scrape away the thin outer skin of the ginger. The scraped skin accumulates on the board. (5) The peeled ginger is then sliced into very thin, translucent rounds using the knife. The slices pile up on the cutting board. (6) A blue ceramic pot of water sits on a black induction cooktop. A spoonful of white salt is added to the water. A silver strainer is placed inside the pot. (7) The ginger slices are poured from a blue tray into the boiling water within the strainer to blanch. After one minute, the strainer is lifted, and the ginger is drained and placed into a large metal mixing bowl to cool. (8) Ingredients for the marinade are presented on a wooden surface: a bottle of pure brewed vinegar, a bottle of white balsamic vinegar, a bowl of brown sugar, and a small dish of salt. (9) Clear liquid vinegar is poured into a glass measuring cup, then a darker liquid (balsamic) is poured into a small metal bowl. (10) In a red ceramic pot on the stove, the clear vinegar, reserved pink ginger tips, salt, and brown sugar are combined and stirred with a wooden spoon. The mixture is brought to a slow simmer for 2 minutes. (11) The cooled ginger slices in the metal bowl are squeezed by hand to remove excess water. (12) The hot marinade and the white balsamic vinegar are poured over the squeezed ginger. Everything is stirred together with a wooden spoon until well combined. (13) The pickled ginger is transferred into two small, round glass containers. The pink ginger tips are added for color, and the liquid is poured to cover all slices. (14) Blue vacuum lids are placed on the jars, and a manual white vacuum pump is used to seal them. (15) A woman with shoulder-length dark hair, wearing a white t-shirt and a dark blue apron, appears in a bright, modern dining room. She holds the two jars and smiles warmly at the camera. (16) She uses chopsticks to eat a slice of ginger from a bowl, reacting with wide eyes and a smile of satisfaction.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Slogan]: 健康、開胃涼拌菜. [Slogan]: 糖醋嫩薑. [Slogan]: 按照這比例！超好吃. (2) [Slogan]: 約600克嫩薑. [Subtitle]: 選擇頭粉粉的顏色... (3) [Slogan]: 先將粉色的地方切除掉. [Subtitle]: 粉色部分要先保留下來. (4) [Slogan]: 用小刀刮掉嫩薑表面的老皮. [Subtitle]: 側邊的地方也要刮掉. [Subtitle]: 這樣做出來口感才會嫩！ (5) [Slogan]: 接著將嫩薑切成薄片. [Subtitle]: 你也可以用刨片器會更快. [Subtitle]: 兩者都可以自由選擇. (6) [Slogan]: 煮一鍋水. [Slogan]: 水裡加入適量的鹽. [Slogan]: 放上一個過濾網會比較方便！ (7) [Subtitle]: 水滾之後，把嫩薑片放進來汆燙1分鐘. [Subtitle]: 不要煮太久喔！ [Slogan]: 立刻撈起來瀝掉水分. [Slogan]: 一旁瀝乾、放涼. (8) [Slogan]: 準備一罐純釀的醋還有白巴薩米克醋. [Slogan]: 一點鹽還有適量的糖. (9) [Slogan]: 需要詳細食譜請留言 +「1」. [Subtitle]: 我會建議大家用好一點的醋來做. [Subtitle]: 這個之後還可以泡飲料喝喔！ (10) [Slogan]: 先放純釀的醋. [Slogan]: 薑頭部分. [Slogan]: 鹽、糖放進來. [Slogan]: 中小火慢慢煮滾. [Slogan]: 大約煮1~2分鐘關火. (11) [Slogan]: 將放涼的薑片擠乾水分. (12) [Slogan]: 把剛剛煮好的糖醋汁倒進來. [Slogan]: 巴薩米克醋放進來. [Slogan]: 攪拌混合均勻. (13) [Subtitle]: 等薑都放涼之後... [Slogan]: 再移到玻璃容器裡. [Slogan]: 粉色薑頭放進來. [Slogan]: 糖醋汁也放進來蓋過所有的薑片. (14) [Slogan]: 蓋上蓋子抽真空. [Subtitle]: (抽真空可以更快醃漬完成). [Slogan]: 現在就可以放入冰箱靜置入味一天. (15) [Subtitle]: 好囉～糖醋嫩薑醃漬好了！ (16) [Slogan]: 試吃一下！❤️. [Subtitle]: 酸酸甜甜的，讚喔！ [Subtitle]: 哇哇哇！這也太好吃了吧！❤️. [Slogan]: 更多美味料理請追蹤我 IG 臉書：蘿潔塔的廚房 YouTube:@RosalinaKitchen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with bright, rhythmic acoustic guitar strumming accompanied by a light, steady percussion beat. A friendly, high-pitched female voice provides an enthusiastic greeting in Mandarin, perfectly synced with the upbeat BGM. (2) As the cutting starts, rhythmic thudding sounds from the knife striking the cutting board are audible over the music. The female voice explains the ginger preparation steps with clear, professional articulation. (3) A sharp, metallic scraping sound is heard as the skin is removed from the ginger. The BGM remains consistent in tempo, providing a steady rhythmic backbone to the sequence. (4) Rapid, percussive slicing sounds occur as the ginger is cut into thin pieces. The narrator's speech rate increases slightly to match the faster editing cuts, maintaining a high positive valence. (5) Bubbling and gentle boiling water sounds emerge as the ginger is blanched. A distinct metallic clink is heard when the strainer is placed in the pot, layered over the continuous acoustic guitar BGM. (6) The sound of liquid pouring into glass and metal containers is heard clearly. The narrator's tone becomes more instructional and calm while explaining the marinade ingredients. (7) A percussive clinking of a wooden spoon against a ceramic pot occurs during the boiling of the marinade. The music swells slightly in volume during a brief pause in speech. (8) A distinctive whirring and suction sound of the manual vacuum pump sealing the jar lids is present, providing a satisfying mechanical audio feedback. (9) The final phase features the narrator's excited vocalizations ('Wa wa wa!') with high pitch variability, followed by a crisp crunching sound as she tastes the finished ginger. The BGM ends with a clean final chord.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Ingredient Introduction -> Sequential Preparation -> Final Assembly -> Tasting & CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To provide a clear, step-by-step instructional guide on how to make healthy, appetizing pickled ginger at home using high-quality ingredients and a vacuum-sealing method to ensure flavor infusion.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video focuses on personal recipe sharing and self-promotion of social media channels rather than a specific paid product placement.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high density of text overlays and fast-paced editing characteristic of modern social media cooking content. The use of a vacuum pump as a technical 'hack' serves as a unique selling point for this recipe.
